import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    # t loop runs once, so just read all ints sequentially
    t = int(next(it))  # t is 1, but we read it anyway
    n = int(next(it))  # actually n is the first number, but not used
    a1 = int(next(it))
    a3 = int(next(it))
    a2 = int(next(it))
    b1 = int(next(it))
    b3 = int(next(it))
    b2 = int(next(it))
    
    max_val = 0
    if a1 > b3:
        max_val += b3
    else:
        max_val += a1
    if a2 > b1:
        max_val += b1
    else:
        max_val += a2
    if a3 > b2:
        max_val += b2
    else:
        max_val += a3
    
    min_val = 0
    if a1 > b2 + b1:
        min_val += max(a1 - (b2 + b1), 0)
    if a2 > b3 + b2:
        min_val += max(a2 - (b3 + b2), 0)
    if a3 > b1 + b3:
        min_val += max(a3 - (b1 + b3), 0)
    
    print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
